20
Bobe turo mu adwumayɛfoɔ
1 # Mat 21.33 Na ɔsoro ahennie te sɛ onipa bi a ɔyɛ afuowura a ɔfirii adi anɔpatutuutu sɛ ɔrekɔbɔ adwumayɛfoɔ paa akɔ ne turo mu. 2Na ɔne adwumayɛfoɔ no dii ano sɛ da koro denare baako no, ɔmaa wɔkɔɔ ne bobe turo mu. 3Na ɔfirii adi bɛyɛ anɔpa nnɔnkron kɔhunuu afoforɔ sɛ wɔgyinagyina dwa ase kwa. 4Na ɔsee wɔn nso sɛ: Mo nso monkɔ me bobe turo mu, na akatua a ɛyɛ no na mede bɛma mo. 5Na wɔkɔeɛ. Bio, ɛbɛyɛ awia dummienu ne nnɔn mmiɛnsa no, ɔfiri adi kɔyɛɛ saa ara. 6Na ɛbɛyɛ anwummerɛ nnɔnnum mu no, ɔfirii adi kɔhunuu afoforɔ sɛ wɔgyinagyina hɔ kwa, na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Adɛn nti na mogyinagyina ha kwa adekyeeɛ nyinaa yi? 7Wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Obiara mmɔɔ yɛn paa. Ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Mo nso monkɔ bobe turo mu hɔ! 8Na ɛduruu anwummerɛ no, bobe turo no wura no ka kyerɛɛ ne hwɛsoni sɛ: Frɛ adwumayɛfoɔ no, na ma wɔn wɔn apaadeɛ firi wɔn a wɔdi akyire so kɔsi wɔn a wɔdi kan so. 9Na wɔn a wɔfaa wɔn bɛyɛ anwummerɛ nnɔnnum baeɛ no, wɔn nyinaa nyaa denare denare. 10Na adikanfoɔ no baeɛ no, wɔsusuu sɛ wɔbɛnya deɛ ɛkyɛne saa; na wɔn nso nyaa denare denare. 11Na ɛkaa wɔn nsa no, wɔnwiinwii afuowura no so 12sɛ: Akyikafoɔ yi deɛ, dɔnhwere baako pɛ na wɔyɛɛ adwuma, na woama wɔn ne yɛn a yɛfiri anɔpa ayɛ adwuma na owia ahye yɛn no pɛ. 13Na ɔbua see wɔn mu baako sɛ: Awɛ, menyɛɛ wo bɔne; wo ne me anni ano denare anaa? 14Fa wo deɛ na kɔ! Menni kwan sɛ mema deɛ ɔbaa akyire yi sɛ wo, 15#Rom 9.16; 9.21 anaasɛ menni ho kwan sɛ mede me ara m’adeɛ meyɛ deɛ mepɛ anaa? Sɛ me yam yɛ nti na w’ani abere yi? 16#Mat 19.30; 22.14 Saa na akyikafoɔ bɛdi kan, na adikanfoɔ adi akyire; (na wɔafrɛ bebree nanso kakraa bi na wɔayi wɔn.) #20.16 Tete atwerɛ a wɔgye tomu binom mfa saa ɔfa yi a ɛwɔ nkahyɛmudeɛ yi nka ho.
Yesu wuo ne ne wusɔreɛ ho nkɔmhyɛ a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa
(Marko 10.32-34; Luka 18.31-33)
17Na Yesu reforo akɔ Yerusalem no, ɔfaa dummienu no nko ara kɔɔ nkyɛn, ɔkwan no mu, ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: 18#Mat 16.21; 17.22-23 Hwɛ, yɛreforo akɔ Yerusalem, na wɔbɛyi Onipa Ba no ahyɛ asɔfoɔ mpanimfoɔ ne Atwerɛfoɔ nsa, na wɔabu no kumfɔ, 19na wɔde no ahyɛ amanaman mufoɔ nsa sɛ wɔngoro ne ho, na wɔnka no mpire na wɔmmɔ no asɛnnua mu, na da a ɛtɔ so nnansa no ɔbɛnyane bio.
Ɔsoro ahennie mu dibea
(Marko 10.35-45)
20 # Mat 10.2 Ɛnna Sebedeo mma no na, ne ne mma baa ne nkyɛn bɛkotoo no, na ɔsrɛɛ ne hɔ biribi. 21#Mat 19.28 Na Yesu bisaa no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na wopɛ? Ɔbua see no sɛ: Ka ma me mma mmienu yi mu baako ntena wo nifa, na ɔbaako nso ntena wo benkum w’ahennie no mu. 22#Mat 26.39; Yoh 18.11; Luk 12.50 Na Yesu buaa sɛ: Monnim deɛ morebisa. Mobɛtumi anom kuruwa a merebɛnom no anaa? (Anaasɛ, mobɛtumi ama wɔde asubɔ a wɔde rebɛbɔ me no abɔ mo anaa?)#20.22 Tete atwerɛ a wɔgye tomu binom mfa saa ɔfa yi a ɛwɔ nkahyɛmudeɛ yi nka ho. Wɔsee no sɛ: Yɛbɛtumi. 23Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Me kuruwa deɛ mobɛnom, (na m’asubɔ nso mobɛnya,)#20.23 Tete atwerɛ a wɔgye tomu binom mfa saa ɔfa yi a ɛwɔ nkahyɛmudeɛ yi nka ho. na me nifa ne me benkum tena deɛ, ɛnyɛ me dea sɛ mede bɛma, na wɔde bɛma wɔn a m’agya asiesie ama wɔn.
Ɔsom na ɛpagya onipa
24 # Luk 22.24-26 Na edu no teeɛ no, anuanom baanu no asɛm no anyɛ wɔn abodwoɔ. 25Na Yesu frɛɛ wɔn bae, na ɔkaa sɛ: Monim sɛ wiase amanaman ahemfo di wɔn so sɛ awuranom, na wɔn mu akɛseɛ no di wɔn so tumi. 26#Mat 23.11 Na ɛnte saa mo mu; na mmom obiara a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ kɛseɛ mo mu no, ɔnyɛ mo somfoɔ, 27#Mar 9.35 na obiara a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔdi kan mo mu no, ɔnyɛ mo akoa, 28#Luk 22.27; Flp 2.7; 1 Ti 2.6 sɛdeɛ Onipa Ba no amma sɛ wɔnsom no, na mmom ɔbɛsomee, na ɔde ne nkwa bɛyɛɛ agyedeɛ maa nnipa pii ne no.
Anifirafoɔ mmienu adehunu
(Marko 10.46-52; Luka 18.35-43)
29Na wɔfiri Yeriko rekorɔ no, nkurɔfokuo pii dii n’akyi. 30Na hwɛ, anifirafoɔ mmienu a wɔtete kwankyɛn tee sɛ Yesu retwam no, wɔteateaa mu sɛ: Hu yɛn mmɔbɔ, Awurade, Dawid ba! 31Na nkurɔfokuo no kaa wɔn anim sɛ wɔmmua wɔn ano. Ɛno mmom ma wɔteateaa mu denden sɛ: Hu yɛn mmɔbɔ, Awurade, Dawid ba! 32Na Yesu gyina frɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na mopɛ sɛ meyɛ ma mo? 33Wɔsee no sɛ: Awurade, ma yɛn ani mmue! 34Na Yesu hunuu wɔn mmɔbɔ, na ɔde ne nsa kaa wɔn ani; na ntɛm ara wɔhunuu adeɛ, na wɔdii n’akyi.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na ɔsoro ahennie te sɛ onipa bi a ɔyɛ afuowura a ɔfirii adi anɔpatutuutu sɛ ɔrekɔbɔ adwumayɛfoɔ paa akɔ ne turo mu. Na ɔne adwumayɛfoɔ no dii ano sɛ da koro denare baako no, ɔmaa wɔkɔɔ ne bobe turo mu. Na ɔfirii adi bɛyɛ anɔpa nnɔnkron kɔhunuu afoforɔ sɛ wɔgyinagyina dwa ase kwa. Na ɔsee wɔn nso sɛ: Mo nso monkɔ me bobe turo mu, na akatua a ɛyɛ no na mede bɛma mo. Na wɔkɔeɛ. Bio, ɛbɛyɛ awia dummienu ne nnɔn mmiɛnsa no, ɔfiri adi kɔyɛɛ saa ara. Na ɛbɛyɛ anwummerɛ nnɔnnum mu no, ɔfirii adi kɔhunuu afoforɔ sɛ wɔgyinagyina hɔ kwa, na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Adɛn nti na mogyinagyina ha kwa adekyeeɛ nyinaa yi? Wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Obiara mmɔɔ yɛn paa. Ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Mo nso monkɔ bobe turo mu hɔ! Na ɛduruu anwummerɛ no, bobe turo no wura no ka kyerɛɛ ne hwɛsoni sɛ: Frɛ adwumayɛfoɔ no, na ma wɔn wɔn apaadeɛ firi wɔn a wɔdi akyire so kɔsi wɔn a wɔdi kan so. Na wɔn a wɔfaa wɔn bɛyɛ anwummerɛ nnɔnnum baeɛ no, wɔn nyinaa nyaa denare denare. Na adikanfoɔ no baeɛ no, wɔsusuu sɛ wɔbɛnya deɛ ɛkyɛne saa; na wɔn nso nyaa denare denare. Na ɛkaa wɔn nsa no, wɔnwiinwii afuowura no so sɛ: Akyikafoɔ yi deɛ, dɔnhwere baako pɛ na wɔyɛɛ adwuma, na woama wɔn ne yɛn a yɛfiri anɔpa ayɛ adwuma na owia ahye yɛn no pɛ. Na ɔbua see wɔn mu baako sɛ: Awɛ, menyɛɛ wo bɔne; wo ne me anni ano denare anaa? Fa wo deɛ na kɔ! Menni kwan sɛ mema deɛ ɔbaa akyire yi sɛ wo, anaasɛ menni ho kwan sɛ mede me ara m’adeɛ meyɛ deɛ mepɛ anaa? Sɛ me yam yɛ nti na w’ani abere yi? Saa na akyikafoɔ bɛdi kan, na adikanfoɔ adi akyire; (na wɔafrɛ bebree nanso kakraa bi na wɔayi wɔn.)


Na Yesu reforo akɔ Yerusalem no, ɔfaa dummienu no nko ara kɔɔ nkyɛn, ɔkwan no mu, ka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Hwɛ, yɛreforo akɔ Yerusalem, na wɔbɛyi Onipa Ba no ahyɛ asɔfoɔ mpanimfoɔ ne Atwerɛfoɔ nsa, na wɔabu no kumfɔ, na wɔde no ahyɛ amanaman mufoɔ nsa sɛ wɔngoro ne ho, na wɔnka no mpire na wɔmmɔ no asɛnnua mu, na da a ɛtɔ so nnansa no ɔbɛnyane bio.


Ɛnna Sebedeo mma no na, ne ne mma baa ne nkyɛn bɛkotoo no, na ɔsrɛɛ ne hɔ biribi. Na Yesu bisaa no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na wopɛ? Ɔbua see no sɛ: Ka ma me mma mmienu yi mu baako ntena wo nifa, na ɔbaako nso ntena wo benkum w’ahennie no mu. Na Yesu buaa sɛ: Monnim deɛ morebisa. Mobɛtumi anom kuruwa a merebɛnom no anaa? (Anaasɛ, mobɛtumi ama wɔde asubɔ a wɔde rebɛbɔ me no abɔ mo anaa?) Wɔsee no sɛ: Yɛbɛtumi. Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Me kuruwa deɛ mobɛnom, (na m’asubɔ nso mobɛnya,) na me nifa ne me benkum tena deɛ, ɛnyɛ me dea sɛ mede bɛma, na wɔde bɛma wɔn a m’agya asiesie ama wɔn.

Na edu no teeɛ no, anuanom baanu no asɛm no anyɛ wɔn abodwoɔ. Na Yesu frɛɛ wɔn bae, na ɔkaa sɛ: Monim sɛ wiase amanaman ahemfo di wɔn so sɛ awuranom, na wɔn mu akɛseɛ no di wɔn so tumi. Na ɛnte saa mo mu; na mmom obiara a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ kɛseɛ mo mu no, ɔnyɛ mo somfoɔ, na obiara a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔdi kan mo mu no, ɔnyɛ mo akoa, sɛdeɛ Onipa Ba no amma sɛ wɔnsom no, na mmom ɔbɛsomee, na ɔde ne nkwa bɛyɛɛ agyedeɛ maa nnipa pii ne no.


Na wɔfiri Yeriko rekorɔ no, nkurɔfokuo pii dii n’akyi. Na hwɛ, anifirafoɔ mmienu a wɔtete kwankyɛn tee sɛ Yesu retwam no, wɔteateaa mu sɛ: Hu yɛn mmɔbɔ, Awurade, Dawid ba! Na nkurɔfokuo no kaa wɔn anim sɛ wɔmmua wɔn ano. Ɛno mmom ma wɔteateaa mu denden sɛ: Hu yɛn mmɔbɔ, Awurade, Dawid ba! Na Yesu gyina frɛɛ wɔn sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na mopɛ sɛ meyɛ ma mo? Wɔsee no sɛ: Awurade, ma yɛn ani mmue! Na Yesu hunuu wɔn mmɔbɔ, na ɔde ne nsa kaa wɔn ani; na ntɛm ara wɔhunuu adeɛ, na wɔdii n’akyi.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
